plan.scope: all related unit selectors recommended by the unchanged path mapping, always including the dictionary contract; browser recommendations reported separately
plan.cleanup: tests/test_e2e_servers.py plus the automatic global dictionary contract
plan.first_feedback: wall time until the complete recommended related-unit group returns; no reuse; excludes subsequent browser acceptance
plan.isolation: existing host-state lock held by the experiment coordinator; no additional mutex; waiting reported separately
plan.coverage: all 1256 original unit IDs retained, with additional concurrency guards; all 20 browser scenario IDs and 780 original checks retained; compare assertions through AST in addition to identities
plan.failures: retain all original baseline failures and exploratory candidate failures; only completed passed samples enter performance medians
plan.baseline_browser_policy: Three whole-success browser runs; retain the successful browser group from a failed unit run as excluded diagnostic data.

measurement: Group child_seconds for full suites; stricter complete CLI wall for local feedback. Shared host-state coordinator prevents competing participating verification. No reuse.

business_assertions.method: Count Python assert statements, assert* calls and browser ok calls, using ast.dump without source coordinates. Changed timing guards in test_verify_entry are independently reviewed separately.

handoff_demo.scope: Synthetic serve-check only; PR and CI gates execute separately

independent_review.head: b69fc47ebda3792126ead9ef457d17f46e21dedc
independent_review.method: Independent mp-code-review agents reviewed original implementation and incremental lifecycle, stdout and CI fixes. Previously identified blockers were corrected and re-reviewed. Static review; agents did not run product tests. Final evidence prose and data are reviewed separately before merge. The later fixed-sleep hook test fix was reviewed independently on both axes with no blockers.

limitations: One Darwin arm64 host; CPython 3.14.6; n=3 each. No population percentiles or all-developer time claims.

The manual controlled comparison intentionally changes runner/strategy/environment execution mode. Automatic cohort comparators must keep these versions separate. All original behavior IDs and business assertion ASTs remain, with added lifecycle guards.
Local probes are synthetic comments or legal JSON whitespace. The entire recommended related-unit group returns; additional planned browser acceptance is separate.
Known failed attempts and the CI Python 3.12 cancellation-write failure are retained, not replaced by success. A passed browser group inside an overall failed run is excluded from baseline medians.
Existing locks coordinate participants, not unrelated machine activity. Lock wait is separate; wall clocks affected by suspended sessions are not performance evidence.
Metadata-only evidence/report commits after the measured candidate require their own final PR gate and CI. Those IDs belong to the PR to avoid changing protected inputs repeatedly.
